**Description**
The AuthRuntimeClient (ARC) team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Software Development Engineer to build, deliver, and maintain complex products that delight our customers and raise our performance bar. ARC handles every single request across all AWS Services, sustaining over a billion transactions per second. We are building the most secure, reliable, scalable, and performant authentication and authorization platform on the planet. On this team, you'll have the opportunity to tackle challenging technical problems, innovate for services across all of AWS, and contribute to our high bar on security for all of our customers. You will thrive by being creative, responsible, and curious, working with your team to quickly turn code into customer solutions. This role is for people who are passionate about the massive cloud computing opportunity, delivered high-quality solutions in hyper-growth environments, and want to solve challenging problems at unparalleled scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base.
  
  
**You Will**

* Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
* Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
* Build high-quality, highly available, always-on products.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and solve complex problems from first principles.
* Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers.
* Launch, own, support, and continuously improve your solutions for the benefit of our customers.

A day in the life
  
  
As you design and code solutions to help our team improve authorization across AWS, you’ll write design docs, implement improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.
  
  
**You’ll Also**

* Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
* Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
* Work in a fast-paced development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

**About The Team**
The AuthRuntimeClient team provides authentication and authorization to all services at AWS. We are a critical part of how customers around the world access their resources, which give us global reach and scale. ARC sits at the center of security and innovation, often needing novel approaches to solve complex problems spanning millions of customers and most AWS services. While we move fast, we also have to look around corners and anticipate the peculiar ways AWS services work. On the ARC team, every day is a different challenge!
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**About Ramp**
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
  
  
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
  
  
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
  
  
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
  
  
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Applied AI team at Ramp is at the forefront of leveraging AI to drive innovation across our platform. We are seeking strong full-stack engineers who are proficient in web frameworks, backend development, and infrastructure. You will work on exciting projects such as AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Structured Extraction (we made https://github.com/1rgs/jsonformer), internal tooling for customer-facing teams, fine-tuning models, and build infrastructure for LLM inference. If you're passionate about working on real production use cases of large language models (LLMs) and want to contribute to groundbreaking AI applications, this role is for you.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Ship full-stack AI projects end to end
* Build and integrate components for AI infrastructure, supporting production-level inference and fine-tuning
* Develop and improve engineering processes, tools, and systems to scale AI solutions across Ramp
* Create tools and internal platforms to enhance the productivity and capabilities of Ramp's AI and engineering teams

What You Need
  
  

* Proficiency in full-stack development, with a strong understanding of web frameworks, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure
* A track record of working on full-stack AI projects, particularly those involving production use cases of LLMs
* Experience building backend systems and infrastructure that can support AI-driven products

Blossom Health exists to
**solve the mental health epidemic**
in America by partnering with psychiatrists to expand access to affordable, timely, clinically effective mental healthcare. Our
**AI-native care platform**
is loved by hundreds of clinicians and tens of thousands of patients.
  
  
We’re a
**Series A**
company with
**$20M+ raised**
from Headline, Village Global, and the founders of General Catalyst, Flatiron Health, Sword Health, Fay, Elemy, Zip, Blank Street, Assured, Bridge, Birches Health, and Enzo Health.
  
  
**The Role:**
We're looking for an
**Applied**
**AI Engineer**
to build and ship the intelligent systems powering the next generation of psychiatric care.
  
  
You'll work closely with our engineering team to design, develop, and deploy
**AI-native products and LLM-powered agents**
that automate complex healthcare workflows and fundamentally improve how clinicians deliver care.
  
  
This
**isn't a role focused on building AI demos or experimenting with models in isolation**
. You'll take emerging AI capabilities from prototype to production, owning everything from system architecture and implementation to evaluation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
We're looking for someone with
**exceptional software engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience shipping AI products, and the ambition to build at the frontier of applied AI in a high-growth startup.**
**Why You Should Work Here:**

* 🚀 Be early in a hyper-growth startup: Join a foundational engineering team and help shape the AI infrastructure, architecture, and products behind Blossom's next stage of growth.
* Build AI products that actually matter: Your work will directly improve how clinicians deliver care, reduce administrative burdens, and expand access to mental healthcare for thousands of patients.
* 🤝 High trust and autonomy: Own meaningful technical challenges from day one, make architectural decisions, and have the freedom to take ideas from concept to production.
* 🧠 Talent-dense engineering team: Work alongside exceptional engineers from Meta, Apple, and AWS who bring high technical standards, intellectual curiosity, and a shared ambition to build something consequential.
* Move at the frontier of AI: Experiment with emerging models, agentic systems, and new AI capabilities while solving complex, real-world problems in healthcare.

**What You'll Do:**

* Build AI-native product experiences: Design, develop, and ship intelligent features used directly by clinicians and patients across Blossom's platform.
* Engineer LLM-powered agents and workflows: Build systems that automate and augment complex clinical and operational processes through tool calling, retrieval, and intelligent orchestration.
* Own AI products end-to-end: Take features from initial exploration and prototyping through production deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and iteration.
* Build reliable, production-grade AI systems: Develop evaluation frameworks, observability, and feedback loops to continuously improve accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.
* Design scalable application infrastructure: Work across Python, TypeScript, model APIs, backend services, retrieval systems, and integrations to support increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities.
* Translate emerging AI capabilities into real products: Rapidly experiment with new models and techniques, identify practical applications, and turn promising ideas into measurable improvements.
* Collaborate directly with clinicians and engineers: Understand complex healthcare workflows, identify high-impact opportunities, and build solutions grounded in real user needs.
* Shape our engineering direction: Contribute to technical architecture, development practices, and foundational decisions as our engineering team and AI platform scale.

**You'll Be a Good Fit If:**

* You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in a highly technical, high-performing engineering organization or venture-backed technology startup.
* You have hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered applications or AI products in production, beyond prototypes or personal projects.
* You're highly proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, with strong fundamentals in software design, backend development, and system architecture.
* You've worked with modern LLM APIs, agentic systems, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, or similar applied AI technologies.
* You understand the engineering challenges behind production AI systems, including evaluations, reliability, latency, cost optimization, observability, and failure modes.
* You can independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and take solutions from concept to production.
* You're comfortable working across the stack and quickly learning new models, frameworks, and technologies.
* You have strong product instincts and care about building technology that delivers measurable value to real users.
* You thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly and there isn't always an established playbook.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* You're authorized to work in the United States.
* You're excited to work in-person in New York City, 5 days a week.

**Bonus:**
You've worked as a software engineer at a
**high-growth, venture-backed startup or top-tier technology company**
, where you've independently owned and shipped production AI products, agentic workflows, or complex distributed systems.
  
  
**What We're Looking For:**

* Highly motivated, ambitious, and capable: You want to tackle large, meaningful technical problems and hold yourself to an exceptionally high bar.
* Ownership mindset: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just code, and approach engineering challenges with a founder's mentality.
* High velocity and high excellence: You move quickly, ship consistently, and take pride in building reliable, well-engineered products.
* Technically rigorous: You think deeply about architecture, scalability, performance, and failure modes rather than settling for solutions that simply work in a demo.
* Product-minded: You understand that great engineering is about solving real problems and creating meaningful value for users.
* An explorer: You're energized by ambiguity, experimentation, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with emerging technologies.
* Humble: You value feedback, collaborate openly, and use your strengths in service of the team.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* $150,000–$220,000 base salary
* Meaningful equity ownership
* Significant growth opportunities as the company scales
* Beautiful, sunshine and snack-filled office in the heart of Flatiron, Manhattan
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* A focus on outcomes, not hours
* Team outings, offsites, and unlimited PTO
